create_ptv_resnet: create a single pathway ResNet video model using PyTorchVideo with config for c2d, slow, or i3d architectures
create_ptv_slowfast: create a two pathway SlowFast video model with configurable alpha, beta, and fusion parameters
create_ptv_x3d: create an X3D video model with configurable width factor, depth factor, and bottleneck factor
create_ptv_csn: create a CSN video model with separable convolutions and configurable depth
create_ptv_r2plus1d: create an R(2+1)D video model with separable spatio-temporal convolutions
create_ptv_mvit: create a Multiscale Vision Transformer video model with configurable patch embedding and attention
get_head_act: get a head activation function module from a string name like softmax or sigmoid
